content.title: Arizona basketball turns back Purdue to reach Final Four
content.text: March 28, 2026Updated March 29, 2026, 9:57 a.m. MTThe Arizona Wildcats turned back Purdue in an Elite Eight game at SAP Center Arena in San Jose, California, on Saturday, March 28, to claim a spot in the Final Four.Arizona trailed by seven at the half, but rallied for a 79-64 victory.Koa Peat scored 20 points to go with seven rebounds. Ivan Kharchenkov added 18 points and Brayden Burries and Jaden Bradley finished with 14 points each.Arizona was 20-for-22 from the free-throw line. They shot 33% (5 of 15) from 3.Oscar Cluff led Purdue with a double-double of 14 points and 10 rebounds.The Boilermakers end their season at 30-9. Wildcats scoring advantageArizona has 34 points in the paint, compared to 18 for Purdue.That's just one stat that shows how Arizona is getting its points. The Wildcats have 12 fastbreak points; Purdue has just 3.At the free-throw line, Arizona is 18-for-20, compared to 6-for-10 for Purdue. Fouls piling upTobe Awaka picked up his fourth personal foul with just under 8 minutes to play. The Arizona forward was caught on a fake and came down on top of Purdue's Oscar Cluff.Arizona has 12 team fouls, and Purdue has 13.The Wildcats lead 64-53 with 7 minutes to play. Koa Peat flexingArizona freshman Koa Peat is playing big boy basketball.Peat has a team-high 18 points to go with seven rebounds.The Wildcats have extended their lead to 10 points at 59-49 with 8:20 to play.The crowd's chant has changed from "U of A" to "Arizona". Wildcats holding off PurdueWith 11:46 to play, the No. 1 seed Arizona Wildcats lead Purdue 51-45.Arizona is shooting just 44% from the floor and 27% from 3. However, it is 14-for-16 from the free-throw line. That easily accounts for the difference in the game as Purdue is just 2-for-6 from the line. Arizona regains leadThe Wildcats have the lead at 44-43. It's the first time they have been up since the score was 27-25.Koa Peat is stuck at 14 points, but Ivan Kharchenkov and Jaden Bradley have gotten involved on offense. Peat, Burries keeping Arizona in gameArizona freshman Koa Peat is calling for the ball. After back-to-back makes, Peat fed the ball to another freshman, Brayden Burries for a 3.The 7-0 run by the Wilcats has the game tied at 42-all with 15:21 to play. "U of A" chants are echoing through the building.Peat has 14 points on 6 of 9 shooting. He has three assists and three rebounds.Watch Arizona vs Purdue on Sling Purdue G Braden Smith injuredBraden Smith, the NCAA career leader in assists, turned his ankle while playing defense against the Wildcats.Smith was on his back on the floor and play was stopped. Smith, however, was able to get up and remained in the game. Arizona playing from behindThe Wildcats have not lost a game when trailing at the half this season.But the statistic isn't overwhelming.Arizona has trailed just once at the half this year.They enter the second half against Purdue, trailing 38-31. Purdue leads Arizona at halfThe Boilermakers hit seven 3s to take a 7-point lead into the second half.Braden Smith leads Purdue with 11 points. Gicarri Harris has 6 points and 3 rebounds off the bench.Arizona is led by Koa Peat with 10 points. The Wildcats are shooting just 17% (1 of 6) from 3.Arizona is 8-for-8 at the free-throw line, while Pudue is just 1 of 2.Purdue 38, Arizona 31 (Half) Braden Smith carrying PurdueGuard Braden Smith has 11 points on 4 of 8 shooting. He has three rebounds and two assists.Purdue leads 33-27 with 2:21 left in the first half. The Boilermakers are now shooting 55% (6 of 11) from 3 after getting off to a slow start. Purdue-Arizona tied in first halfWith 3:45 left in the first half, Purdue and Arizona are tied at 27-all.Arizona is 1-for-6 from 3. Most of its shot attempts are clustered near the basket. Ivan Kharchenkov has 6 points on 3 of 4 shooting. He also has 5 rebounds.Koa Peat leads Arizona with 8 points. Purdue back on topWhile Koa Peat and Brayden Burries were off the court for Arizona, Purdue capitalized.The run by the Boilermakers ended with them up 25-21 with 6:52 left in the half.Purdue has gotten 10 points off its bench. Purdue struggling from 3The Boilermakers are getting open looks, but the shots aren't falling.Purdue is just 3-for-8 from 3. Braden Smith made the first two, then Gicarri Harris added one off the bench. Arizona makes a runIn a period of less than 3 minutes, the Wildcats turned the game around.After trailing by a point, they have jumped to a 19-13 lead.Koa Peat has been a facilitator for the Wildcats. he has 4 points and 2 assists.Guard Braden Smith has 8 points for Purdue.Score: Arizona 19, Purdue 13 (11:56 H1) Arizona trailing earlyFor the first time in the NCAA Tournament, the Wildcats are trailing.Sure, it's only by a point, but it is the first time since March Madness began that Arizona has been playing from behind.Score: Purdue 10, Arizona 9 (15:25 H1) Starters for Arizona vs. Purdue in Elite EightPurdue (30-8): G C.J. Cox, So. G Braden Smith, Sr. G Fletcher Loyer, Sr. F Trey Kaufman-Renn, Sr. C Oscar Cluff, Sr.Arizona (35-2): PG Jaden Bradley, Sr. G Brayden Burries, Fr. F Ivan Kharchenkov, Fr. F Koa Peat, Fr. C Motiejus Krivas, Jr. Purdue-Arizona tip-off delayedThe start of the Elite Eight game between Purdue and Arizona has been delayed by 10 minutes and will now start at 5:59 p.m. MST.The change was made to accommodate broadcast coverage of the West Region championship.What time is the Purdue vs Arizona March Madness game?The Arizona vs Purdue NCAA Tournament Elite Eight game is scheduled for 5:49 p.m. MST (8:49 p.m. ET) on Saturday, March 28.What channel is the Arizona vs Purdue Elite 8 game on?The Purdue vs Arizona Elite Eight NCAA Tournament game can be seen on TBS and truTV. How can I stream the Purdue vs Arizona NCAA Tournament game?Arizona vs Purdue can be streamed on Sling TV and other streaming services that carry TBS and truTV. Who are the announcers for the Arizona vs Purdue regional final game?Brian Anderson will have the play-by-play call of the Purdue Boilermakers vs. Arizona Wildcats NCAA Tournament game, with Jim Jackson as the analyst and Allie LaForce as the reporter for the March Madness Elite Eight matchup.What is the Arizona vs Purdue point spread in Elite 8 odds?According to BetMGM Sportsbook, the Arizona Wildcats are a 5.5-point favorite over the Purdue Boilermakers in the Elite Eight round of the NCAA Tournament.
